{{Top}}
{{Quote|You think you can use that mind-trick banthaflop on me? I spent months in a Rimsoo on Drongar, Small Eyes. I watched Barriss Offee use the same thing, practically every day, to calm down patients and&mdash;|Den Dhur, to Jax Pavan|<ref name="CNJT">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref>}}
'''Republic Mobile Surgical Units'''&mdash;'''RMSUs''' (pronounced "'''Rimsoos'''") for short&mdash;were small field [[Medcenter/Legends|hospitals]] used extensively during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to patch up injured [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and other personnel. They were staffed by a full contingent of surgeons, [[Nurse/Legends|nurses]], and [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]], and could be set up close to battlefields and taken down for relocation with less than an hour's notice. Aside from the general medical facilities, staff offices and housing, Rimsoos also housed a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], which served as a place for soldiers, surgeons, nurses, media, and the like to unwind and socialize.<ref name="MBS">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref> On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] during the Clone Wars, there were a total of fifteen of these units.<ref name="MJH">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>

In the aftermath of the [[Declaration of a New Order]], the RMSUs were [[Imperialization/Legends|renamed]] [[Imperial Mobile Surgical Unit/Legends|Imperial Mobile Surgical Units]], or "Imsoos".<ref name="Author's Cut 11">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-11-serving-the-empire|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 11: Serving the Empire}}</ref>

==Capabilities==
In theory, the RMSUs had the facilities and equipment to fix even the most catastrophic wounds, containing such equipment as [[antisepsis field]]s, [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tanks]], and even [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] tanks in which organs could be grown to replace damaged ones. In practice, however, they were often critically undermanned and under equipped, with resupply infrequent and inadequate.<ref name="MBS" /><ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-7-the-grand-army-of-the-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 7 &mdash; The Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref>
